title: Copilot code review: An improved review experience
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Copilot code review now shows review progress over time, groups open/resolved/missed findings, improves auto-resolution, and can generate commit messages for eligible batch suggestions.
actionable_takeaway: Create a Review Progress Receipt that records finding state, severity, human override replies, resolution reasons, and generated commit-message review.

title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases - September 14
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: The weekly rollup connects code review updates, auto model selection tiers, VS Code Agent Host metrics, Sentry canvas, Dev Containers, and agent PR creation into one operator surface.
actionable_takeaway: Audit Copilot workflows as a chain from issue telemetry to local dev container, review, PR creation, and cleanup rather than isolated features.

title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in mid-October
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: GitHub will deprecate selected Copilot models on 2026-10-19, including GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5 mini, Gemini 3.7 Flash, and Grok 4.5, with suggested replacement models.
actionable_takeaway: Run a Model Deprecation Migration Board that maps old model IDs, replacement policies, admin enablement, test fixtures, and user-visible picker changes.

title: Stage-only npm tokens for safer automation
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: npm granular tokens can now stage package versions for review without direct publish permission, giving token-based automation a migration path before the January 2027 bypass-2FA transition.
actionable_takeaway: Move package release workflows from direct npm publish to npm stage publish plus maintainer 2FA approval when trusted publishing is not available.

title: Manage the code coverage ruleset condition with the REST API
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: GitHub REST API can now manage the Restrict code coverage ruleset condition, including minimum line coverage and maximum tolerated coverage drop, for supported plans.
actionable_takeaway: Treat coverage gates as policy-as-code and record repository eligibility, upload status, threshold, allowed drop, and rollout mode.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.155.1 stable
author: OpenAI / GitHub Releases
why_it_matters: Codex 0.155.1 disables reasoning summaries by default for new local TUI sessions, fixing request rejection by providers that do not support them while respecting explicit settings.
actionable_takeaway: Add a Provider Capability Preflight before enabling reasoning summaries, and keep explicit user or repo settings separate from safe defaults.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.156.0-alpha.5
author: OpenAI / GitHub Releases
why_it_matters: The 0.156 alpha line advanced through multiple builds on 2026-09-18 and 2026-09-19, indicating active iteration beyond the 0.155 stable lane but with sparse release notes.
actionable_takeaway: Keep alpha builds in an observation lane unless a specific diff, issue, or local smoke justifies testing them against a disposable workspace.

title: OpenAI Node 7.19.0
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: OpenAI Node 7.19.0 adds API support for webhook endpoint management, extending SDK-controlled operational surfaces beyond chat and response execution.
actionable_takeaway: Add webhook endpoint inventory, signing-secret rotation, event allowlist, and delivery retry checks to SDK upgrade receipts.

title: OpenAI Python 3.16.x
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: OpenAI Python 3.16.0 adds webhook endpoint management, while 3.16.1 avoids unrelated API resource loading on first use and 3.16.2 fixes a parsing memory leak.
actionable_takeaway: When upgrading Python agents, test webhook management separately from startup latency and long-running parse_response memory behavior.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.87-0 prerelease
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: Copilot CLI 1.0.87-0 adds startup defaults for Auto routing tiers, recallable pending prompts, worktreePathTemplate, per-server MCP slow-connection thresholds, and live elapsed time for execution subagents.
actionable_takeaway: Add routing-default, pending-prompt, worktree-location, MCP latency, and subagent-duration fields to CLI runtime receipts.

title: Claude Code v2.1.277
author: Anthropic / GitHub Releases
why_it_matters: Claude Code 2.1.277 adds AGENTS.md fallback support, egress-boundary proxy handling, gateway headers, background-task waiting notices, and fixes several resume/login/update failure modes.
actionable_takeaway: Use it as a comparison checklist for Codex: instruction fallback, proxy egress, background task status, error exit codes, and multi-version logout behavior.

title: Claude Code v2.1.276
author: Anthropic / GitHub Releases
why_it_matters: Claude Code 2.1.276 fixes a 2.1.275 regression where every request could fail with a 400 advisor input-tag error when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points to a proxy or gateway.
actionable_takeaway: Pin agent CLI upgrades behind gateway smoke tests whenever a release touches proxy, base URL, account, or request metadata behavior.
